moqt.note: Every SDK implements draft-ietf-moq-transport-20 and no other version. protocolId is that draft's wire identifier (draft §1.4 rule: "moqt-" plus the draft number), offered as the WebTransport protocol identifier (WT-Available-Protocols / ALPN).

authentication.note: An explicit jwt parameter already present on the URL takes precedence over a token callback. An empty jwt parameter is rejected as an argument error, not treated as absent.

limits.note: moq-relay's implementation limit on an object's encoded property block (MAX_OBJECT_EXTENSIONS since 0.17.0; not a draft-20 limit). The relay stops the subgroup stream on a larger block and the object is lost with no error to the subscriber, so both SDKs refuse such a write as an argument error. limits.maxObjectPropertiesBytes stays the core's draft-20 bound and still applies to track properties and to what a subscriber decodes.
